say:2:1022105001:0.source_cn: 抢劫麦子的盗匪都抓住了吗？

say:3:1022105002:0.text: One of them got away. He was really fast! He would've made a great imperial courier.
say:3:1022105002:0.source_cn: 跑了一个，逃得比闪电还快，如果不当盗匪，他能成为一名优...

say:4:1022105003:0.text: Follow that one, Valen. I'll take these cretins to Holistone for questioning.
say:4:1022105003:0.source_cn: 维伦，你去追，我把这几个混蛋押回圣石镇审讯。

say:5:1022105004:0.text: Got it. I'll be keeping an eye out for supply wagons. There might be more victims other than Lady Joseline. There seems to be a lot of loot here.
say:5:1022105004:0.source_cn: 好，我也会继续关注来往的货车，遭殃的可能不止乔思琳女士...

say:6:1022105005:0.text: Robbery in plain sight and just outside Holistone too... This is too much. They must pay for what they've done.
say:6:1022105005:0.source_cn: 竟然就在圣石镇附近抢劫……简直无法无天，他们必须付出代价。

say:7:1022105006:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm taking them back to the Heroic Order. Could you please return the goods to Traveler's Light? I'll be there soon.
